newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Thin Estonian market sees shares drifting lower.
newsitem.headline: Thin Estonian market sees shares drifting lower.

text.p: The new listing by clothing company Klementi failed to kindle investor interest on Estonia's bourse on Tuesday and the mood on the market remained subdued as prices drifted lower, dealers said.
Total trade on the main list was 33.5 million kroons with the Talse 0.48 percent lower at 252.07.
"The market is very thin with little interest to push it in a clear direction," one dealer said.
Dealers are divided on the cause of the listless market, with some saying that investors have already started their holidays and others saying that more new listings are needed to boost trade.
"Holidays are one explanation, but the existing stocks are high priced and there are new companies coming to the exchange," one broker said.
Hoiupank was the most active with 15.6 million kroons changing hands to lose 0.25 kroons to close at 131.00 kroons.
"A large block of Hoiupank shares went through before trade closed, pushing up the volume," one dealer said.
Hansapank slipped slightly to close at 130.90 kroons, down 1.10 kroons after turning over 4.6 million kroons.
The free market volume was five million kroons with diversified industrialist Nomra the most active.
Norma turned over 3.1 million kroons to firm slightly by 0.10 kroons to close at 72.25 kroons.
